cost_to_income_ratio.formula: (Cost of sales + Marketing and selling expenses + General and administrative expenses) / Revenue

quick_ratio.formula: (Trade accounts receivable + Cash and cash equivalents) / (Short-term borrowings + Current lease liabilities + Trade accounts payable + Income taxes (Current liabilities) + Current provisions and other liabilities)
quick_ratio.reason: A quick ratio of 0.4267 suggests that LVMH has 0.43 EUR of highly liquid assets to cover every 1 EUR of its current liabilities, indicating potential short-term liquidity challenges without relying on inventory.

debt_to_capital_ratio.formula: (Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities) / (Long-term borrowings + Short-term borrowings + Non-current lease liabilities + Current lease liabilities + Equity, Group share + Minority interests)
